scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev --workspace=@triade/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@triade/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@triade/api && npm run build --workspace=@triade/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=@triade/api && npm run lint --workspace=@triade/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@triade/api && npm run build --workspace=@triade/web
